findings.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was a record $83.8 million vs $6.3 million in Q2 2025 (>13x YoY); pro forma organic revenue grew 85% YoY. GAAP gross margin was 43.1% and adjusted gross margin 50.4%.
findings.source_title: Ondas Posts Record Q2 2026 Revenue of $83.8 Million on Strong Bookings and Backlog Growth; Raises Full-Year Outlook

findings.claim: Q2 2026 operating loss was $162.9 million on $199.1 million of operating expenses (including $69.1M stock-based compensation); net loss was $89.7 million and adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $50.6 million.

Ondas raised 2026 revenue outlook to $525-$550 million and guided Q3 2026 revenue of $140-$155 million; it targets adjusted EBITDA profitability for the operating platform by Q4 2026 and company-wide by Q4 2027.
findings.source_title: Ondas to Report Q3 Earnings: Can Orders and Acquisitions Fuel Growth?

findings.claim: Reported backlog was ~$613 million at June 30, 2026, and $757 million pro forma including DZYNE and Cyberhawk, up from $68 million reported backlog at Q4 2025.
findings.source_title: Ondas Posts Record Q2 2026 Revenue of $83.8 Million

findings.claim: Ondas secured >$165 million of orders from late August through Oct 1, 2026, bringing orders since June 30 to >$270 million, including a $56 million Electronic Safe & Arm Devices award from a European neo-prime.
findings.source_title: Ondas Secures Over $165 Million in New Orders Since Last Order Update

findings.claim: Mistral is preparing to deliver against >$240 million of aggregated orders tied to the U.S. Army's $982 million Lethal Unmanned Systems IDIQ, with deliveries ramping in Q3-Q4 2026 and into 2027.
findings.source_title: Ondas Raises 2026 Revenue View: Can It Deliver the Required H2 Ramp?

findings.claim: Ondas acquired DZYNE Technologies for $875.8 million ($200M cash plus ~85 million shares valued ~$675M); DZYNE holders own ~13.8% of Ondas, with 45 million shares subject to a six-month lock-up.
findings.source_title: Ondas Announces Transformative Acquisition of DZYNE Technologies

findings.claim: Ondas closed a ~$1 billion registered direct offering (19.0M shares + 41.8M pre-funded warrants at $16.45) with 121.6 million accompanying common warrants exercisable at $28.00 for seven years; net proceeds ~$959 million.
findings.source_title: Ondas Holdings Inc. Announces Closing of $1 Billion Offering

findings.claim: Shares outstanding rose from 380.8 million (Dec 31, 2025) to 469.1 million (Mar 31, 2026) before the ~85 million-share DZYNE issuance; Q2 2026 basic weighted shares were 500.7 million vs 150.7 million a year earlier.

Ondas ended Q2 2026 with ~$1.4 billion of cash, equivalents, restricted cash and short-term investments and only ~$6.4 million of total debt, though ~$325 million was used in Q3 to close the DZYNE and Cyberhawk acquisitions; liabilities include ~$1.0 billion of warrant liability.
No Ondas subsidiary flew in Drone Dominance Gauntlet II at Fort Carson, although DZYNE competed in Gauntlet I under prior ownership; Ondas remains eligible for future Gauntlets.
findings.source_title: Red Cat Misses the Cut in Pentagon's Latest Drone Dominance Round (CORRECTED)

findings.claim: Rapid serial acquisitions plus a guided ~76% sequential revenue jump in Q3 create integration and execution risk; management also cautioned on H2 2026 gross-margin pressure from mix and excess capacity in acquired businesses.
findings.source_title: Ondas to Report Q3 Earnings: Can Orders and Acquisitions Fuel Growth?

findings.claim: Q1 2026 net income of $361.2 million and Q2 'other income' items were driven largely by non-cash warrant fair-value changes, so GAAP net income is not a reliable indicator of operating profitability.
